gloss_en: spirit/wind (ruach, Aramaic rucha) — the vital breath or animating spirit-force: the life-breath blown into the nostrils, the wind of the lungs that cools the heart, the spirit residing in the tzaddik ('a man in whom there is spirit'); distinct from revach (profit/space) which shares the letters רוח

outliers.reason: Homograph: רֶוַח 'profit' (as the text says, profit is called by the name 'birth'), not רוּחַ 'spirit/wind'
